queue.tree_name: The Old Beech of St Ives Estate
queue.recognise: In woodland among tall Scots pines: a short, thick, ribbed beech trunk green with moss, a wide crown of fine branches, and a great broken limb lying across the leaf litter at its foot.
queue.story:
The St Ives Estate, between Bingley and Harden in West Yorkshire, was a private estate for centuries before Bradford Council took it over in 1974 and opened its woods to everyone. A reader walking there in November sent us this beech.

Among the straight, slim Scots pines it is easy to see why they stopped. The beech is short and thick in the trunk, ribbed and green with moss, and it spreads into a wide crown of fine grey branches that, in the reader's picture, still hold a few copper leaves against a blue sky. It has not had an easy life. A great limb has broken away and lies across the leaf litter at its foot, and their second photograph shows where it tore from the trunk, leaving the wood
queue.name: The Old Beech of St Ives Estate
queue.worth: the tree already has one: ship this only if it is better

queue.recognise: A lone oak in a clearing of rough grass beside a path with a low wooden rail: one straight dark trunk, mossy at the foot, under a wide rounded crown of crooked limbs.
queue.story:
A reader walking in Kiewit, the wooded domain on the northern edge of Hasselt, stopped at this oak and sent us a photograph from the path beside it. They put it at about 350 years old.

The photograph shows why it caught their eye. The oak stands on its own in a clearing of rough grass, a single straight trunk, dark and mossy at the foot, rising clear of the undergrowth before it breaks into heavy, crooked limbs. Nothing has crowded it, so the crown has spread wide in every direction, a great rounded dome against the sky. In the reader's November picture the leaves have turned the colour of old bronze under a clear blue sky, while a maple at the edge of the clearing has already gone yellow.
queue.name: The Oak of Kiewit
queue.worth: the tree already has one: ship this only if it is better
